problems: Cliopatria draws Prussia under other names: the Confederation of the Rhine row (1809-1814), the German Confederation row (1815-1865, 281.7 k km2 in 1820) and the North German Confederation row (1868-1870) cover the Prussian provinces. kingdom-of-prussia uses German Confederation shapes (1820, 1840, 1846, 1853, 1863) as Prussia's land and a computed Tilsit rump for 1807-1814, so the eu-20 dossiers for those rows must treat them as associations (umbrella), not as territory, or the cells are painted twice.

kingdom-of-prussia ends 1 July 1867 (North German Confederation in force; Cliopatria has the Confederation 1868-1870 and the German Empire from 1871 as separate rows), not 1918; Cliopatria's own Kingdom of Prussia row stops at 1863 and its shapes from 1807 are slivers (all marked wrong). The orchestrator may extend the end to 1918 if one colour to 1918 is wanted.

brandenburg-prussia ends 18 January 1701 (the page: 1618-1701); Cliopatria's row runs to 1720 and overlaps the Kingdom of Prussia row in 1702-1717; its 1718-1720 shape (Ghana only) is marked wrong. The Ghana cells of its 1683-1700 shapes are removed in favour of the brandenburger-gold-coast dossier (vassal_start 1682 / vassal_end 15 January 1701, counterpart brandenburger-gold-coast).

Page budget: 9 pages per dossier, the Kingdom of Prussia article shared (17 distinct pages). One of Brandenburg-Prussia's nine, Frederick_William,_Elector_of_Brandenburg, was a disambiguation page opened by mistake; it is listed in sources as unused.
